seed_streams: Independent SeedSequence streams per split/parameter/reset/program/appearance; held-out mapping/seeds private.

camera.note: Square calibrated view; vertical margins preserve equal horizontal/vertical scales.

termination_policy: Stop at first recorded |p| > cart_limit_m; retain that finite state and its force interval.

visibility_policy.checks: Full cart/pole/bob geometry and pole stroke, all frames including terminal overshoot; fail instead of cropping or resampling.

angle_convention: q=0 down, q=pi upright; unwrapped during integration
action_convention: force[k] acts on [t[k],t[k+1]); paired 20 ms hold, odd final entry allowed
